newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST- China inflation seen at 1.5 pct in Q2.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST- China inflation seen at 1.5 pct in Q2.

text.p: China's retail price inflation is expected to rise by about 1.5 percent in the second quarter, the China News Service said on Monday.
It quoted the Information Centre of the State Economic and Trade Commission as making the forecast.
It did not comment on reasons for the modest rise in inflation in the second quarter although inflation has been running well below initial forecasts this year.
Retail price inflation was 2.6 percent for the first quarter and some economists estimate it could be as low as three to four percent for the full year.
